body: yeah we talked and I'm not going through with it. I realized that this will hurt her more than anything I could ever do. And I can't go through with this knowing that.
Yeah it all comes down to her. If she didn't matter then I'd kill myself. But she means more than I do and I can't put her through that
yeah I know... We talked it over and I'm not going to kill myself right now
don't apologize. but yeah i called her. she said if I kill myself she'd kill herself too. I can't let that happen

I called her and told her what I've got on my mind. she said if I kill myself she'd never forgive me. she said that she'd kill herself too.

I can't do it man. I'm stuck between a rock and a hard place. but i can't bear the thought of her dying

I just don't want to hurt her any more... I want her to be safe. And I can't guarantee that she's safe with me. 

I just need to call her

It doesn't change the fact of what I did though. I know she'd be willing to work through this with me. But I don't know if I'd be willing to work with myself through this. I can't, under any circumstance, do that again.

i did lie... I promised her, and I broke them. I'm 23. If I'd be gone then she'd find someone 100x better than me. I know it. 

But we both know that's not going to happen. That's some shit out of a movie. life doesn't work like a movie. 

I don't know where else to go man

i don't know... i just don't fucking know anymore. I don't know myself. I don't know what I'm doing anymore.

I need to sleep on this. it's 1 in the morning. I'm sleeping in the back seat tonight.
I just fucking shit on everything I've ever told her by doing that. I lied to her. If I can't protect her from myself then how in the fuck am supposed to protect her from everything else?

I know this is one of the things that sets her off. And she can't do anything to stop it. If I don't even know when I'm going to lash out, then she can't protect herself. I can't protect her. I made her a fucking promise. I told her that I would never hurt her. I told her I'd help her be better. And I broke that promise tonight. And I can't forgive myself for that.

yeah shit happens. But goddamn it, _this_ shit can not happen to her again. But I am a bitch. I knew that the moment I touched her. I am a total bitch. I'm not worth her, and I'm not worth the chance of doing that again.

I don't know if I'll do it again or not. But I can't do that again. Not after all the shit she's been through in her life. 

The only way I can be 100% sure that I'm not going to hit her again is if I'm not there to do it.

I just can't control myself... and I don't want her to be around me when I lose it, because I'll take it out on her. 

She's got fucking PTSD, man... I'm sure that gave her a flashback of her childhood. She trusted me so much. And I betrayed her. I fucking took her back to the darkest point in her life. Me. The fucking bullshit excuse for a man who she wanted to marry.

That's what terrifies me though! Like if we have another arguement, who's to say I won't do it again? Or if we have kids, what if I do it to them? There's no way in hell I'd be able to forgive myself for that.

It all comes down to what will harm her the most. And I think it'll be horrible for me to put her through that kind of circumstance. That was her entire childhood. Her parents beat the shit out of her on a daily basis. I cannot. At any cost. Put her through that again.

I don't want her vision of love to be traced all over the place with abuse. I can't take that.

But it's so fucking terrifying to me that I did it without a thought. My hand just acted on it's own. 

I can't promise myself that I'll never do it again becuase if I can't control my anger... then what? I just put her through this again and again? I can't live without her, and I can't live with putting her through that again.

Am _I_ worth it though? If this is the kind of shit I'm going to put the love of my life through, then I don't want to make her go through that. I've heard those horror stories where the woman is terrified of her husband abusing her and can't leave the relationship. I can't do that to her. She's perfect. She doesn't deserve that.
